name: [Shoptet CLI Greenfield] Phase 2 — The MVP: Dev Loop & Build
description:
Part of the "Shoptet Partner CLI — Greenfield Rebuild" initiative (label: shoptet-cli-greenfield).

This is the MVP milestone: init + validate + dev + build gives partners exactly what they can do today with shoptet-bender + the boilerplate, in one tool, without the legacy footguns. Zero platform dependency, zero auth. Deploy stays on the legacy SFTP / GitHub-App path until Phase 6.

Scope per cli-greenfield.md §13 Phase 2 / §5.1.1:

- dev-engine core: embedded Vite (middleware mode) + reverse proxy (http-proxy-middleware) + host-header validation + header/cookie handling
- dev-engine injection & feedback: marker-anchored byte-splice injection, SSE hot reload, error overlay, rendered-version assertion, non-blocking production-shop warning
- shoptet dev command wiring + queryable state API (§5.5)
- shoptet build — production build, correct output names, fixes legacy bundling bug §2.6
- Dev-loop test suite: fixture corpus, proxy header fixtures, Playwright e2e (§12)

Depends on the Phase 0 feasibility spike passing.
